Indeed, many of the conscripted recruits were grateful to surrender and even helped defeat some rebels. Also, the fleeing rebels had harassed and attacked rural populations, and expanding would intimidate and drive away militias. Also, the rebels had left a trail of destruction in their wake, and the country was receiving many new immigrants. This created a newfound need for space and also is driving us to expand.
